jobs.description:
**Advanced Reentry Technologies**

**Who We Are:**

  

Inversion is an aerospace and defense company pioneering advanced reentry technology to enable next-generation capabilities from space. By combining high-performance materials, precision aerodynamics, and mission-driven autonomy, Inversion is transforming reentry into an operational capability for an entirely new class of missions.

The company's highly maneuverable reentry spacecraft, Arc, is designed for rapid global cargo delivery, hypersonic testing, and other national security missions that require precise, controlled flight through the atmosphere. Arc creates an entirely new transportation domain, unlocking unprecedented speed and global reach.

Headquartered in Los Angeles, Inversion designs, manufactures, and integrates its spacecraft under one roof, enabling the company to move rapidly from concept to flight. The company is backed by leading investors including Y Combinator, Spark Capital, and Lockheed Martin Ventures, with customers across the U.S. government and commercial space industry.

**Position Overview:**

As a Hardware Test and Automation Engineer at Inversion, you will work as part of the simulation team to build, test, maintain, and develop the automated software and hardware systems that support the simulation and test environments for our flight systems. The simulation team is responsible for ensuring that flight software and flight hardware can be continuously integrated and tested under realistic flight conditions. You will play a key role in the automation of electrical ground support equipment (EGSE) and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) test benches that will enable fast, repeatable development and deployment workflows across the engineering stack. Your work will empower Inversion's engineering teams to iterate rapidly throughout the development life cycle and will strengthen Inversion's ability to put our products into the hands of our customers with unprecedented speed and agility.

* Automate provisioning, deployment, execution, operation, and logging tasks to optimize resource utilization and allocation
* Develop automated test scripts to support qualification efforts for our flight software and hardware systems
* Develop device API wrappers for EGSE equipment (e.g.: to control power supplies, oscilloscopes, etc., via automated test scripts)
* Develop emulators for flight hardware to support software-in-the-loop (SIL) and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing
* Integrate electronics hardware needed to enable on-demand, hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) simulation workflows (this includes building custom harnessing, performing safe to mate procedures, safely powering-up components, troubleshooting hardware interfaces, etc.)
* Contribute to the design and development of a simulation system capable of automatically provisioning and deploying resources to support simulation workflows

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering or equivalent technical experience
* Typically 1+ years of applicable hands-on experience of hardware experience
* Proficiency in one or more scripting languages (Python, Lua, Bash, PowerShell, etc.)
* Proficiency in one or more embedded languages (C/C++, Rust, etc.)
* Experience with Linux-based systems
* Experience handling and integrating unhoused/open-frame custom electronics and prototype hardware
* **Must have the ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government Secret/Top Secret security clearance**

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Experience with data acquisition and logging
* Experience with robotics middleware and autonomy stacks (ROS 2, Webots, Orocos, YARP, etc.)
* Familiarity with modern DevOps practices
* Familiarity with time-series databases (InfluxDB, QuestDB, Prometheus, etc.)
* Familiarity with message-oriented middleware (NATS, Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.)
* Familiarity with containerization (Docker, Docker Compose, etc.)

**Our office headquarters is located in Playa Vista, CA. This position requires in office presence.**

*The California annual base salary for this role is currently $77,000 -$116,000. Pay Grades are determined by role, level, location, and alignment with market data. Individual pay will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: interviews and an assessment of several factors that are unique to each candidate, job-related skills, relevant education and experience, certifications, abilities of the candidate and internal equity.*

**ITAR Compliance:**

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Learn more about the ITAR here.

Inversion provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, veteran status, or disability.

----------------------

**About Sift**
--------------

Sift is the data infrastructure platform for hardware engineering teams. We turn high-frequency telemetry into engineering insights for mission-critical machines: rockets, satellites, autonomous vehicles, energy systems, and defense platforms. Founded by former SpaceX engineers, we are building the review and analysis layer for the AI era of physical systems.

**About The Role**
------------------

Sift is hiring a Senior Software Engineer to build and own the developer infrastructure and testing environments that enable our engineers to ship software faster and with greater confidence.  
You'll design systems that allow engineers to spin up complete, production-like environments on demand to test changes, simulate real-world workloads, and validate correctness. As AI coding agents become increasingly integrated into development workflows, you'll build the infrastructure that enables these agents to independently test, debug, and validate the code they produce.  
Sift processes high-volume telemetry from complex hardware systems, making realistic testing environments particularly challenging. This is a foundational, high-ownership opportunity to architect and scale the infrastructure that powers how we develop, test, and ship software.

**In This Role, You'll:**
=========================

* Design and build infrastructure that provisions isolated, production-like testing environments on demand, enabling engineers to validate changes against Sift's full application stack.
* Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines, build systems, and deployment automation to make testing environments fast, reliable, and cost-efficient.
* Develop infrastructure that supports diverse testing workloads, including integration testing, correctness validation, load testing, and performance testing.
* Build tooling for realistic data generation and user behavior simulation to validate software under production-like conditions.
* Enable AI coding agents to interact with testing environments, execute tests, and validate code changes autonomously.
* Partner closely with engineering teams to understand developer needs, eliminate bottlenecks, and improve development velocity and software quality.

**The Skillset You'll Bring:**
==============================

* 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, with significant experience in developer infrastructure, test infrastructure, platform engineering, or developer tooling.
* Deep hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, build systems, and deploying applications to cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* Experience building and automating developer infrastructure, deployment systems, or testing environments, with an understanding of scalability, performance, and reliability.
* Experience developing or optimizing CI/CD pipelines and automating infrastructure provisioning and deployments.
* Strong software engineering and programming skills, preferably in Go or Python.
* Ability to balance infrastructure performance, environment fidelity, reliability, and cost.
* Strong collaboration skills and a developer-focused mindset, with experience building tools that improve engineering productivity.

**Bonus Points:**
=================

* Experience building ephemeral or on-demand development and testing environments.
* Load testing, performance testing, or distributed test execution.
* Browser automation and end-to-end testing tools such as Playwright or Cypress.
* Building sandboxed execution environments or infrastructure supporting AI coding agents.
* Working on developer infrastructure at a fast-scaling technology company, cloud platform, or compute provider.

**Engineering at SIFT:**
========================

You'll have the opportunity to help evolve and scale our platform because we're still in the early stages of building the product. Relevant technologies include:

* **Web frontend & backend:** ECharts, Go, gRPC, PostgreSQL, Protobuf, Radix, React, Redux, and TypeScript
* **Data**: Arrow, DataFusion, Flink, Parquet, and Rust
* **Infrastructure:** Argo CD, AWS, Docker, GitHub Actions, Grafana, Kubernetes, Kustomize, Linux, Prometheus, and Terragrunt

**Location:**
=============

Sift’s headquarters is in **Marina Del Rey, CA** (Next to LAX). We collaborate **in person** twice a week—on **Mondays and Thursdays**—and come together for a full week every two months. We are open to **relocating candidates to LA** or **working from our San Francisco** office for the right candidate.

Salary range: $180,000 - $230,000 per year. Plus equity and benefits.

**Eligibility:**
================

**U.S. Person Required**: Must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, or protected individual such as an asylee or refugee in compliance with ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations) / EAR (Export Administration Regulations) regulations.

Compensation Range: $180K - $230K

Stanbridge University is seeking **Software Engineers – AI Systems (Go)** to design, build, and operate production AI systems that perform complex, multi-stage work reliably and at scale.

The core engineering challenges extend well beyond prompt development. These systems must account for provider failures and rate limits, interrupted workflows, changing state, non-deterministic model behavior, incorrect or unsupported outputs, variable latency and cost, and deployments occurring while work is in progress.

The successful candidate will combine strong **software and distributed-systems engineering judgment** with practical experience building and operating **LLM-backed applications, AI agents, or agent-based systems in production**.
